column6: Parse an owner Slack reply into a canonical first-token outcome plus comments, or a verbatim §4.5 NACK (spec-owner-io §4). Pure; does not post.
Durable Slack outbox (spec-owner-io §7 / C-17): pending-delivery until Slack ack; local query by state/kind/channel_id/goal_id/ask_id and get-by-id.

Sends the record-owner-ask gateway intent (open | reap) for the owner-ask record, and READS the fleet-wide open-ask set back through the inspect asks target (a refusal answers null, never an empty list). Holds no store handle: the daemon stamps open_asks (spec-state-store §3; owner ruling 2026-08-24).

Thread-per-ask posting and the ONE ask-release door (spec-owner-io §2.1/§2.4/§3): opens a new goal-channel thread per ask batch, stamps the ❓/💭 opening line with the thread id it minted, mints a record only for ❓, and releases an ask only on an authorized sender's parsed reply in that exact thread. No oldest-open and no `re:` fallback.

Wires ask-thread.js into production: builds the ask door, resolves the goal channel for postAsk (the bus ferry's ❓ leg), holds the persisted askThreads map (<channel>:<threadTs> -> goal/seat/askId), and routes an inbound message in an ask thread to release before every other leg.

The §3 approval first message (GOAL NAME + IRREVERSIBLE as their own bold lead lines, bound commit_id, published tokens) and the §4.2 post-parse dispatch keyed on the ask's kind: approve is D12 only in a genuine approval thread; reject-and-close/pause/retry, retry with:, close; the [T3-R22] three-key pause; [C-16] failure post-back into the same thread. Effects are injected ports.

The mechanical pause/resume door (spec-owner-io §4.2/§4.4/§4.5) and the resume-semantics table (spec-recovery §4 [C-14]): target resolution incl. bare verb in a goal channel, the verbatim mechanical NACK on zero/several matches, goal paused<->running, named-event re-arm of a counter-exhausted lane, refusals for blocked-on-human and gate-cap. Never releases an ask; holds no store handle.

Wires approval-thread.js and pause-resume.js into production: kind/commitId/paused on the persisted askThreads entries, the kind fork after release, the reap-suppressed later reads of a paused approval thread, and the mechanical door ahead of the master doors for top-level goal-channel and DM messages. The D12 materialize port is BUILT here from the gateway forwarder (start-execution.js) and an injected materialize is refused at construction; the remaining ports (closeGoal, pauseGoal, relaunchDraftVerify, endingStore, listSeats, listLiveGoals) are injected and unwired by main().

The ONE changed-only SYSTEM digest (spec-owner-io §5 / T5-R13, C-12): the ten America/Sao_Paulo 2-hourly slots, the (ask ids + one_liners + condition signatures) snapshot compared against the last DELIVERED payload (persisted, restart-safe), the asks -> conditions -> links rendering, and the kind=digest post through the outbox. Reads open conditions via an injected alarm-registry port; emits nothing.

The bot status line (spec-owner-io §6 / T4-R5, D-6-ruling): renders exactly `N waiting · oldest Xh · M blocked` from injected ask/blocked readers and writes the bot's Slack status text on the seven listed triggers only. Never posts a channel message; holds no outbox and no transport.

Sends the start-execution gateway intent (the 14th, owner ruling 2026-08-24 option (b)) carrying goal + approval thread + bound commit. Fills approval-thread.js's materialize port; holds no child process: the daemon-side executor runs the supervised Path-B birth and a refusal is posted back into the approval thread [C-16].

Wires the system digest and the status line into production (spec-owner-io §5/§6): the 30-second slot driver started by index.js#main(), the open-ask reader over the gateway, the open-condition reader over observation/emitter.js's published read interface (reloaded per read, with a post that throws so the bridge can never emit), and the transport status port. An unreadable ask set skips the slot rather than posting an empty digest; no system channel is a loud refusal.
The bus-answer leg: records an owner answer arriving over the bus against the open ask it closes (moved from engine/ by spec-component-map §2)
The chat bridge harness session settings (moved from config/)
The seed the owner-executed install step copies to create the gateway sender allowlist (moved from config/)
